chapter_seo_title: The Annihilation of Snowdragon Mountain – Desolate Era Chapter 316
chapter_meta_description: Nine squads of Gold-ranked Imperial Guards descend on Snowdragon Mountain, shattering its formations with golden divine dragons and leveling the entire sect. Dong Qi is captured alive—vengeance is at hand.
og_title: Golden Dragons Descend: Snowdragon Mountain Is Wiped Off the Map
og_description: Nine squads of Gold-ranked Imperial Guards turn Snowdragon Mountain into rubble. Dong Qi is dragged back to the capital in chains.
twitter_title: Snowdragon Mountain gets crushed by golden dragons—Dong Qi captured alive!
twitter_description: Prince Yan’s Gold-ranked Imperial Guards make Snowdragon Mountain into a lake. Total annihilation.

lore_anchors.definition: The elite imperial guard corps of the Grand Xia Dynasty, each squad consisting of one Loose Immortal leading forty-nine Primal Daoists, capable of merging their power into a ten-thousand-li divine dragon.
A cultivator who failed the Heavenly Tribulation but managed to preserve their soul, surviving at a price—eternal torment from periodic, ever-intensifying Tribulations.
The fifth major cultivation realm in Ki Refining, where the cultivator’s soul matures into a Primal, granting telepathic control, divine sense, and the ability to manifest clones.
The fundamental internal dimension of a Ki Refiner, replacing the mundane dantian; destroying it cripples the cultivator’s foundation permanently.
Magical armor inscribed with runes that allows multiple soldiers to unify their strength into a single entity or phantom, amplifying joint attacks exponentially.
